alerts.title: Renal Function Decline
alerts.message: Guidelines recommend monitoring renal function in patients on TDF. Patient's creatinine levels have been rising over the years (0.9 in 2020 to 1.4 in 2026), indicating a decline in renal function. This could be due to TDF toxicity, but other factors like dehydration or sepsis should also be considered.
